source.description: Camera index (e.g. 0), video file path ('cctv.mp4'), or RTSP/HTTP network stream

recording.description: Recording duration in seconds when pressing [C] hotkey or using --record-snippet

detection._comment_skip: Run Haar detection every N+1 frames (0=every frame, 2=every 3rd). Reuses last bboxes in between. Saves CPU significantly.
detection._comment_ds: Scale factor for detection frame (0.5 = half resolution). Detections are mapped back to full-res. Range: 0.1-1.0.

multiprocessing.description: Protects CPU by limiting concurrent worker processes for multi-face analysis

snapshots.description: Directory where full CCTV frame snapshots [S] are saved
